caption:
A test showing 99 percent purity sounds like proof 🔬 Purity answers one question: how much of the sample is a single compound. It does not say which compound that is. Identity and purity are separate measurements, and usually only one of them gets shown.

What a certificate does and does not prove: pepsafe.info
